# CodingDatafy

> On a mission to build the world's largest reference and knowledge base for coding.

CodingDatafy is an open-source, edge-rendered developer reference platform providing distraction-free, privacy-first technical documentation across programming languages, frameworks, APIs, protocols, and databases[cite: 1].

## Core Reference Index
- Homepage: https://www.codingdatafy.com/
- Languages: https://www.codingdatafy.com/languages
- Frameworks: https://www.codingdatafy.com/frameworks
- APIs: https://www.codingdatafy.com/apis
- Protocols: https://www.codingdatafy.com/protocols
- Databases: https://www.codingdatafy.com/databases
- Tools: https://www.codingdatafy.com/tools
- Compatibility: https://www.codingdatafy.com/compatibility
- Development: https://www.codingdatafy.com/development
- Roadmaps: https://www.codingdatafy.com/roadmaps
- Glossary: https://www.codingdatafy.com/glossary
